_about: The trailer's sound-effect kit (T3), generated with ElevenLabs (trailer/tools/eleven.py sfx). 'use' says where each one goes in the treatment.

sounds.name: braam
sounds.prompt: Massive cinematic movie trailer braam: a huge, deep, distorted brass horn blast with a sub-bass boom and a long dark reverb tail

sounds.name: impact
sounds.use: hard cuts, name cards, montage hits
sounds.prompt: Huge cinematic trailer impact hit: a deep boom with a metallic crash and a short reverb tail

sounds.name: logo_hit
sounds.prompt: Epic cinematic logo reveal hit: an enormous deep boom with a shimmering metallic ring that fades out slowly

sounds.name: riser
sounds.prompt: Cinematic tension riser: a rising, swelling whoosh with strings and noise climbing in pitch, ending abruptly

sounds.name: sub_drop
sounds.use: under cuts and the Dark Brandon drop
sounds.prompt: Deep cinematic sub-bass drop, a heavy rumbling boom falling in pitch

sounds.name: whoosh
sounds.prompt: Fast cinematic whoosh transition, air rushing past the camera, short and punchy

sounds.name: thunder
sounds.prompt: Distant rolling thunder over a dark sky, deep, ominous and slow

sounds.name: record_scratch
sounds.prompt: A vinyl record scratch as the music stops abruptly, comedic

sounds.name: tape_stop
sounds.prompt: A tape stop: music slowing down and pitching down to a halt

sounds.name: glint
sounds.prompt: A single bright cartoon sparkle glint, a high metallic ting, like sunlight flashing off sunglasses

sounds.name: snore
sounds.prompt: A gentle comedic cartoon snore: one long snore in, a soft little whistle out

sounds.name: typing
sounds.prompt: Fast typing on a smartphone touchscreen keyboard, light soft taps

sounds.name: ping
sounds.prompt: A single soft smartphone notification ping

sounds.name: coins
sounds.prompt: A shower of gold coins falling and clinking onto a pile, cascading and bright

sounds.name: cash_register
sounds.prompt: An old mechanical cash register ringing: cha-ching bell

sounds.name: stamp
sounds.prompt: A heavy rubber stamp slammed onto paper on a wooden desk, one loud thud

sounds.name: wall_rise
sounds.prompt: A heavy stone and brick wall rising out of the ground, rumbling with falling debris

sounds.name: card_flick
sounds.prompt: A single playing card flicked and whooshing through the air, crisp paper flutter

sounds.name: card_wave
sounds.prompt: Dozens of playing cards fluttering and whooshing past the camera at once, a big papery swoosh

sounds.name: relic_chime
sounds.prompt: A magical shimmering chime, a bright sparkle as a treasure appears

sounds.name: laser_charge
sounds.prompt: A sci-fi laser charging up: a rising electric hum with crackles, getting more intense

sounds.name: laser_beam
sounds.prompt: A massive sci-fi laser beam blast: a powerful, sustained roaring energy beam with crackling
